# ItsDangerous

Sign data with a secret key so you can hand it to an untrusted place (a cookie,
a URL, an emailed link) and know it was not changed when it comes back.

[badge: PyPI]
[badge: Python]
[badge: License]
[badge: Tests]

```bash
pip install itsdangerous   # Python 3.10+
```

```python
from itsdangerous import URLSafeSerializer, BadSignature

s = URLSafeSerializer("secret key", salt="auth")
token = s.dumps({"id": 5, "name": "itsdangerous"})
s.loads(token)          # {'id': 5, 'name': 'itsdangerous'}
s.loads(token + "x")    # raises BadSignature: the token was changed
```
